note: These are production heuristics, not guaranteed virality or copied creator formats.

rules: show the subject on frame one
put the strongest claim in the first 1.5 seconds
introduce a meaningful visual change every 2-3 seconds
never count a caption-only change as a new visual
use UI only when the narration describes software
give the character a readable reaction
return to the opening motif at the ending
keep captions below the mouth and above platform controls
place restrained SFX on visual events
avoid sound effects on every cut
